subSteps.heading: Have you used NAD+ before, {userName}?
subSteps.caption: Knowing your past experience with NAD+ helps us plan safely and effectively.
subSteps.question: Have you ever used NAD+ by patch, IV infusion, injection or nasal spray?

subSteps.heading: Tell us about your past NAD+ experience
subSteps.caption: Share any reactions, side effects, or benefits you noticed.
subSteps.question: Please describe and include any reactions, side effects and/or benefits you may have experienced.
subSteps.note: If you've never used NAD+ before, you can simply write 'N/A'.

subSteps.heading: Are you comfortable self-injecting NAD+?
subSteps.caption: Some people prefer patches or sprays instead of self-injections.
subSteps.question: Do you feel comfortable drawing up the NAD+ solution and injecting yourself using an insulin-sized needle and syringe?

subSteps.heading: If injections make you uneasy...
subSteps.caption: There may be alternatives like patches or nasal sprays.
subSteps.question: You may want to consider an alternative approach to administering NAD+, such as patches or nasal sprays. If not, describe why you wish to proceed with the injection despite your discomfort with administering your own injection.
subSteps.note: You can also mention if you're open to other administration methods.
